checklist.detail: #bls_ina_se1_com_1s_nomad_camp is a Background community with no entries in the registry, so its whole-community activation may spawn nothing on its own; vanilla used entry None with phase 'default' there. If the camp is still empty aside from the sq004 crowd, that activation is the first thing to check on the tour.

checklist.detail: The guards' chosen phases are the *_ws_guard_leave_* ones: relaxed rifle-guard workspots, but named 'leave', so a tour should confirm they stay put at the gate instead of walking out of the camp.

checklist.detail: Weapon vendor and ripperdoc presence depends on inland_avenue_se1_vendors.questphase actually running its nomads=1 toggles; worth a look-at check in game.

checklist.detail: Whether the camp's radio (#q114_nomad_camp_02_player_radio) is close enough to the entrance to fire the proximity wait when the player drives in; if not, a gate terminal or the camp stash device would be the alternative anchor.

checklist.label: Normal business
checklist.detail: The place looks like an ordinary day: no quest dressing, blood, debris or crime scene.

checklist.label: People at their posts
checklist.detail: The people are there and doing their routine; nobody alert, hostile or in a combat stance.

checklist.label: You can get in
checklist.detail: Doors, gates and lifts you would expect to use work, or there is an in-world way through.

checklist.label: Calm and on post: #ina_04_com_outpost_crew (2 unmapped)
checklist.detail: No spot map, so their posture is unknown; confirm they stand or work calmly, not alert or in combat: antenna_car/0spawn, chase_car_01/0spawn.

checklist.label: Watch the boxing pair in the garage bay.
checklist.detail: Watch the boxing pair in the garage bay. The brawler and the android should both spawn on the synced robot-boxing workspots and spar calmly; if only one appears the synced spot failed and the pair should be dropped.

checklist.label: Count the calm crew: twelve entries on post, nobody in a combat stance.
checklist.detail: Count the calm crew: twelve entries on post, nobody in a combat stance. The three agitated patrol entries (droid, droid_up, guard_05) are deliberately not activated.

checklist.label: Walk up to the guard booth and check the way in.
checklist.detail: Walk up to the guard booth and check the way in. The motel front sliding door is closed and unpowered in vanilla with no terminal, keycard or skill check wired to it, so confirm the door policy opens it or it is quickhackable.

checklist.label: Check the garage window shutter #ina_04_dvc_shutters.
checklist.detail: Check the garage window shutter #ina_04_dvc_shutters. Vanilla forces it open as the gig's secondary route; confirm whether a quickhack still opens it or the window route is lost, and that the garage door covers the loss.

checklist.label: Look at the two parked vehicles.
checklist.detail: Look at the two parked vehicles. The radar van and the Emperor should sit parked without objective markers or quest locks, and the van should be the P9D/2.161 prototype the technician is working on.

checklist.label: Check the outpost's turrets and cameras (#ina_04_dvc_turret_01, #ina_04_dvc_turret_02, #ina_04_dvc_turret_004, #ina_04_dvc_camera_004).
checklist.detail: Check the outpost's turrets and cameras (#ina_04_dvc_turret_01, #ina_04_dvc_turret_02, #ina_04_dvc_turret_004, #ina_04_dvc_camera_004). No restored phase drives them, so confirm they stay passive while you walk the yard and do not start a combat event.

checklist.label: Enter the yard and watch the Militech crew's attitude.
checklist.detail: Enter the yard and watch the Militech crew's attitude. The always-loaded gameplay devices prefab carries a #ina_04_dvc_security_area_restricted volume, so confirm whether walking in counts as trespass and turns the outpost hostile; if it does, the crew cannot be met calmly.

checklist.label: Check the upper walkway sentry.
checklist.detail: Check the upper walkway sentry. guard_08 stands about 13 m above the yard on the motel's upper level; confirm he is on a real walkway with a standing patrol pose and not floating or stuck against a rail.
